package.author: Kang Lin <kl222@126.com>
package.description: A open source remote desktop and remote control. Support VNC, RDP, Terminal, SSH, TELNET, network tools, player etc

en-US.author: Kang Lin <kl222@126.com>
en-US.description: A open source remote desktop and remote control. Support VNC, RDP, Terminal, SSH, TELNET, network tools, player etc
en-US.longDescription:
Rabbit Remote Control is an open-source, cross-platform, multi-protocol remote control software.
Allows you to use any device and system from anywhere and remotely manage any device and system in any way.
Its goal is to be simple, convenient, secure and easy to use, improving work efficiency.
It includes remote desktop, remote control, file transfer (FTP, SFTP), terminal, remote terminal (SSH, Telnet), player, network tools, and more.
en-US.name: Rabbit Remote Control
en-US.releaseNotes: Fix play is not sound in msvc

zh-CN.longDescription:
玉兔远程控制是一个开源、跨平台、支持多协议的远程控制软件。
能让你在任何地方使用任何设备和系统通过任意方式远程管理任意设备和系统。
它的目标是简单、方便、易用、安全、提高工作效率。
它包括远程桌面、远程控制、文件传输（FTP、SFTP）、终端、远程终端（SSH、TELNET）、播放器、网络工具等功能。
zh-CN.name: 玉兔远程控制
zh-CN.releaseNotes: 修复在 msvc 下不能播放声音
